metadata.description: Personal cross-agent skills library — everyday workflows authored once in the portable Agent Skills format.

plugins.name: everyday-skills
plugins.description: Everyday skills: model-council (consult a council of AI models in parallel — synthesize / judge / critique modes over subagent, CLI, or OpenRouter backends), brief (answer-first, concise replies), inception (turn rule lists for agents into the principle they derive from), and interview-me (interview you about code / writing / UI / docs taste and save it to ME.md).
